newsitem.title: POLAND: ComputerLand to take over programmer.
newsitem.headline: ComputerLand to take over programmer.

text.p: Polish software firm ComputerLand SA signed a takeover agreement with programming firm Computer Systems for Business International SA (CSBI), ComputerLand said in a statement on Monday.
Under the deal ComputerLand would take 87 percent to 100 percent of CSBI shares in exchange for 545,762 shares issued to CSBI shareholders plus a cash amount based on CBSI's 1996 financial results.
CBSI, operating in Poland since 1990, is one of the country's three largest programmers, with a 1995 turnover one third of ComputerLand's turnover, the statement said. @
ComputerLand's had sales of 102.1 million zlotys in 1995.
The statement said the CBSI shareholders would have to hold on to their new shares for two years and that the move would widen ComputerLand's product range.
